newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise as yen drops.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise as yen drops.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Wednesday, backed by the yen's continued drop against the dollar and a rise in Thai rubber offer prices to Japan, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen to 3.6 yen per kg higher. The benchmark July contract was up 0.2 yen at 159.1 yen.
In continued bullish sentiment, prices opened firmer.

"Market energy gained momentum after most of futures broke above the psychological resistance point of 160 yen from the outset," one trader said. The view that the dollar is fundamentally strong, also sparked fresh buying, he said.
